title: Request
description: Add a new endpoint to a REST integration (V186 flat shape).

description.title: Description
description.description: LLM-facing description shown in the tool definition.

path.title: Path
path.description:
URL path appended to the integration's base_url. Must NOT start with `/` — the path is
joined onto the base URL (which already carries the leading slash). Supports `{param}` substitution.

input_schema.title: Input Schema
input_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's input arguments.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Static headers merged into every request.

static_body_fields.title: Static Body Fields
static_body_fields.description:
Static body fields merged into POST/PUT/PATCH bodies. Keys are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers
(e.g. ``/meta/tool_name`` for nested, ``/foo`` for a root-level field).

body_format.title: Body Format
body_format.description: Outbound body encoding for write methods.

response_template.title: Response Template
response_template.description: Jinja template (sandboxed, StrictUndefined) rendered against the parsed JSON response.

max_response_length.title: Max Response Length
max_response_length.description: Truncate the rendered string to this many chars. 0 = no truncation.

retry_on_status.title: Retry On Status
retry_on_status.description: HTTP status codes that trigger a retry.
